registration_note: Declared 2026-10-12 before any round-1 data was loaded. Round-1 research (research_notes/Leveraged short horizon search/round1_*.md) found that published intraday edges at 15m-2h are 0.5-1.3 bp per trade, an order of magnitude below the 14 bp round-trip cost, so those are screened out a priori by the authors' own numbers rather than spent as trials. One candidate is eligible and codable.

screened_out.15m_reversal_kitron_wengrowicz: authors' own gross edge ~1.3 bp/trade vs >= 5 bp cheapest round trip; not exploitable by their numbers
screened_out.quarter_hour_minutes_shanaev: positive only at zero fees (Bitfinex 2021); out-of-sample coefficients a third of in-sample
screened_out.first_vs_last_half_hour: full text not obtained; windows/costs unverified
screened_out.btc_altcoin_lead_lag: rules only from an unreviewed repo with tuned thresholds and maker-fill assumption
screened_out.quarter_hour_taker_imbalance: authors decline to present a trading rule; effect ~1/20 of a round trip
screened_out.taker_price_volume_imbalance_sort: explained by the same two-factor model as the basis sort (thesis); not an independent candidate
screened_out.category_momentum: CoinMarketCap categories not point-in-time; category subset chosen after viewing overlap
screened_out.adaptive_trend_6h: key parameters unpublished; edge mostly from monthly re-optimisation; trend variant
screened_out.vol_scaled_crypto_portfolios, semivolati: full text not obtained; parameters unverified

candidates.source: Pengfei Luo, 'Three Essays on Futures Expected Returns', PhD thesis, University of Edinburgh 2024, ch. 3 (pp. 60-61, 81-85, Table 19)
candidates.universe: every Binance USDT-M perpetual that has a matching Binance spot USDT pair, listed >= 1 day, with trailing 1-day perp dollar volume > 1,000,000 USD at the sort time; delisted contracts included; stablecoin bases excluded
candidates.data: Binance archive 1h klines for perps (data/futures/um/.../klines/{SYM}/1h) and spot (data/spot/.../klines/{SYM}/1h), mark-price 1h klines for liquidation checks, fundingRate history
candidates.signal: y_t = ln(F_t) - ln(S_t), with F_t and S_t the close of the 1h bar ending at the funding settlement time t in {00:00, 08:00, 16:00 UTC}
candidates.portfolio: each settlement, quintiles on y_t; long the lowest quintile, short the highest, equal-weighted within each leg, gross 1.0 (0.5 per leg)
candidates.entry_exit: enter at F_t (the same close used for the signal, as published), exit at the close of the 1h bar ending at t+8h; perp positions only (no spot leg)
candidates.returns: perp price return of each position plus realized funding cash flows on held notional for settlements in (t, t+8h]; costs 14 bps round trip on traded notional per the search protocol
candidates.perturb_note: entry_delay 1h = enter and exit one hour after the signal close (guards against bid-ask bounce / same-price execution); counts in G6 like the other perturbations
candidates.null: allocation: each settlement the real long and short leg sizes are assigned to random distinct eligible contracts (999 draws, seed 20261012), same holding and accounting

implementation_notes.before: the single round-1 run; no real-data result computed
implementation_notes.spot_matching: exact-name spot USDT pair, plus scaled perps (1000X, 10000X, 1000000X ...) mapped to spot X with y = ln(F/k) - ln(S)
implementation_notes.eligibility: listed >= 1 day = 24 hourly bars ended; trailing 24h perp quote volume strictly > threshold; at least q eligible contracts per settlement, else no book
implementation_notes.quintiles: bucket = floor(rank*q/n), stable sort, ties by column order; weights +0.5/n_long, -0.5/n_short
implementation_notes.funding: cash flow -w * sum(rate) for settlements in (entry, exit], settlement times rounded to the minute; 4h/1h funding contracts contribute all their settlements; funding archive ends 2026-09-30 so the last kept period enters 2026-09-30 08:00
implementation_notes.exits: exit at the last perp close in (entry, exit] if the contract stops trading; a delayed-entry position with no entry price is not taken
implementation_notes.costs: 7 bps per unit of sum|w_new - w_old| at each rebalance; first book against zero
implementation_notes.daily_stamping: period P&L, cost and turnover assigned to the UTC day of entry
implementation_notes.entry_delay: signal decided at t; entry at the close of the bar ending t+1h; exit 8h later; funding window shifted accordingly
implementation_notes.null: one random permutation of eligible contracts per settlement; 999 draws; seed 20261012; statistic = mean daily gross over development days
implementation_notes.relisting: perp split at gaps > 30 days; spot kept unsplit and used only where a spot bar exists at t
implementation_notes.liquidation: adverse mark move >= 1/L - 0.005 from the entry fill, measured on mark 1h high/low of bars ending in (entry, exit] => loss |w| * (1 + 0.005 L); period costs scale with L; period return floored at -100%; ruin = equity < 50% at a period end; stationary bootstrap mean block 10, 365 days, 5000 paths, common index matrix across L; max safe L = largest L with ruin <= 5% and zero historical liquidations
implementation_notes.g8: crypto trend core reference only (descriptive SPY omitted for a crypto candidate)
implementation_notes.funding_integrity_activity: a contract counts as trading only on bars with quote_volume > 0: the Binance archive keeps publishing flat zero-volume bars for delisted perps (e.g. AGIX through 2026), which the first run's integrity check (stopped before any statistic was computed) wrongly treated as active. Strategy eligibility (volume > 1M) was never affected.
